name: thirsty-beaches-kiosk-server
description: Thirsty Beaches kiosk server — portable Node.js, loopback-only

notes.remote-pay-cloud: Clover official SNPD SDK. Loaded ONLY when PAY_ENABLED=true in kiosk-config.env.
notes.ws: Node WebSocket polyfill required by the remote-pay-cloud SDK (browser-first library). Pure JS — no native .node addons needed.
notes.zero-dep-posture: These packages are the single deliberate exception to the zero-dependency ethos. They load lazily inside flex-pay.js and are never touched when PAY_ENABLED=false.
